feat(transport): answer list_sessions over the socket

The frames validated but nothing answered them: sessionStore was never
handed to the message pipeline, so a real client asking for its
conversations got silence.

Threads the store into createMessageHandler beside the orchestrator and
answers list_sessions off the per-session lock - a history request is
not a turn. Non-turn frames now answer through one chain per socket, so
a list that awaits the store still reaches the client ahead of the ping
sent behind it. The user comes from the session, never the frame; a
store without listFor answers an empty session_list; a listFor that
rejects logs on the ws category with the user and error and answers
SERVER_ERROR.

Lifts the scaffolding the new acceptance suite copied from the resume
suite - eventually, the drain-before-stop teardown and delegatingTo -
into wsTestSupport, which is what the duplicate-code and
prefer-early-return lint errors were about.

Refs #144

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
